name: Nomi
tagline: Turn anything into something you actually remember.
pitch: Nomi is an AI study platform that turns notes, PDFs, and videos into flashcards, notes, mind maps, quizzes, podcasts, and study guides — then quizzes you on them with spaced repetition so knowledge sticks.
positioning: Nomi is not a generic chatbot. It is an end-to-end study workflow: ingest material (PDF / YouTube / notes / photo) → Nomi structures it (notes, summary, mind map) → Nomi tests you (flashcards, quizzes, spaced repetition) and even explains it back as a podcast. The value is retention + time saved, not 'AI magic'.
foundedNotes: Do not invent founders, founding year, funding amounts, or company history. If asked, say the information is not public.
freeTier: A free plan covers core generation (notes, flashcards, quizzes, summaries, mind maps). Paid plans add higher usage limits, AI podcasts, and additional languages.
